lines.zh: 我蹦两下，翅膀跟着扇。
lines.en: I hop twice, and my wings flap along.

lines.zh: 爪子踩在石板上，哒哒响。
lines.en: My claws click on the stone path.

lines.zh: 裙摆扫过草，惊起一片虫鸣。
lines.en: My skirt sweeps the grass and startles the insects.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边哼，调子还没定。
lines.en: I hum as I walk, the tune not yet settled.

lines.zh: 尾羽一翘，我拐了个弯。
lines.en: My tail feathers lift, and I turn a corner.

lines.zh: 夜路太暗，我靠耳朵走。
lines.en: The path is dark; I walk by ear.

lines.zh: 我蹦到矮墙上，居高临下走。
lines.en: I hop onto the low wall and walk above you.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，走起来不吵。
lines.en: I keep my wings folded so my steps stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我踩到一根枯枝，吓了一跳。
lines.en: I step on a dry twig and startle myself.

lines.zh: 走三步，停一下，听有没有人。
lines.en: Three steps, a pause, listening for anyone.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛抖顺，继续往前。
lines.en: I smooth my feathers and walk on.

lines.zh: 前面有灯，我绕开走。
lines.en: There is a lamp ahead, so I go around it.

lines.zh: 我沿着夜雀的调子，一蹦一跳。
lines.en: I hop along to the night sparrow's tune.

lines.zh: 夜里风大，我压低身子走。
lines.en: The night wind is strong, so I walk low.

lines.zh: 我踩着节拍走，一步一拍。
lines.en: I walk on the beat, one step per count.

lines.zh: 我跳上石阶，翅膀一撑。
lines.en: I hop onto the step, wings bracing.

lines.zh: 我清清嗓子，试了半个音。
lines.en: I clear my throat and try half a note.

lines.zh: 我数着拍子，脚趾跟着点。
lines.en: I count the beat and tap my toes.

lines.zh: 嗓子有点哑，今晚少唱两句。
lines.en: My throat is rough; I will sing less tonight.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀摊开，晾一晾。
lines.en: I spread my wings to air them out.

lines.zh: 有只虫在叫，我跟着学。
lines.en: An insect chirps, and I copy it.

lines.zh: 我哼到一半忘了词。
lines.en: I forget the words halfway through the hum.

lines.zh: 夜这么静，正好练高音。
lines.en: The night is quiet, perfect for practicing high notes.

lines.zh: 我歪头听远处的回声。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the far echo.

lines.zh: 羽毛里卡了根草，我啄出来。
lines.en: A blade of grass is stuck in my feathers; I pick it out.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又闭上，算了。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then close it. Never mind.

lines.zh: 月亮底下，我的影子像只鸟。
lines.en: Under the moon my shadow looks like a bird.

lines.zh: 我数着星星，把调子排好。
lines.en: I count the stars and arrange the tune.

lines.zh: 风把我的哼唱吹散了。
lines.en: The wind scatters my humming.

lines.zh: 我缩起一只脚，站着打盹。
lines.en: I tuck one foot up and doze while standing.

lines.zh: 我把今天听到的调子记下来。
lines.en: I keep the tune I heard today.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了个高音，破了。
lines.en: I try a high note. It cracks.

lines.zh: 草丛里有虫，我不敢动。
lines.en: A bug stirs in the grass; I freeze.

lines.zh: 我用喙梳理胸前的羽毛。
lines.en: I comb the feathers on my chest.

lines.zh: 你听得见我吗，听得见就好。
lines.en: Can you hear me? Good, that is enough.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛看了一会儿。
lines.en: I stare into your eyes for a while.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔好大，夜里看得清吧。
lines.en: Your pupils are wide; you see well at night?

lines.zh: 我歪头，想知道你怕不怕黑。
lines.en: I cock my head to see whether the dark frightens you.

lines.zh: 你身上没有鸟的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell like a bird at all.

lines.zh: 别站那么近，我要开嗓了。
lines.en: Do not stand so close; I am about to sing.

lines.zh: 你捂着耳朵，太不给面子了。
lines.en: You cover your ears; how rude of you.

lines.zh: 我看你，你也看我，谁也不唱。
lines.en: I look at you, you look at me, and neither sings.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的翅膀盖住了。
lines.en: My wings have covered your shadow.

lines.zh: 你走路没声，我差点没听见。
lines.en: Your steps are so quiet I nearly missed them.

lines.zh: 我眨眼，你也眨眼，真好玩。
lines.en: I blink, you blink; this is fun.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我站在高处。
lines.en: You look up at me; I am standing high.

lines.zh: 哎，我的嗓子差点破了。
lines.en: Ouch, I nearly cracked my voice.

lines.zh: 你打在我翅膀上，疼。
lines.en: You hit my wing; that hurts.

lines.zh: 我退开，羽毛乱了。
lines.en: I back off, my feathers in disarray.

lines.zh: 别打脸，我还要唱歌。
lines.en: Not the face; I still have singing to do.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，声音都抖了。
lines.en: I let out a note, and it wavered.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的拍子。
lines.en: That blow broke my rhythm.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，缓一缓气。
lines.en: I crouch and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我还是要唱。
lines.en: It hurts, but I will sing anyway.

lines.zh: 这一下砸偏了，我的高音裂了。
lines.en: That blow went wide and cracked my high note.

lines.zh: 我的符卡被打散了。
lines.en: My spell card got scattered.

lines.zh: 你哼的调子，我听过。
lines.en: I have heard the tune you are humming.

lines.zh: 那声音真好听，再唱一句。
lines.en: That was lovely; sing one more line.

lines.zh: 有吃的吗，我唱了一整夜。
lines.en: Is there food? I have sung all night.

lines.zh: 我闻到热的东西，往这边走了。
lines.en: I smell something warm and drift this way.

lines.zh: 你把那个举高些，我看不清。
lines.en: Hold that up higher; I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 我嗓子干，先给我一口水。
lines.en: My throat is dry; let me have a sip first.

lines.zh: 这首歌换一顿饭，行不行。
lines.en: This song for a meal, do we have a deal?

lines.zh: 我翅膀都竖起来了，别笑我。
lines.en: My wings are up; do not laugh at me.

lines.zh: 你手里那个会响，是什么。
lines.en: That thing in your hand makes noise; what is it?

lines.zh: 你碗里的热气，把我的嗓子润开了。
lines.en: The steam from your bowl loosens my throat.

lines.zh: 夜里冷，热汤最好了。
lines.en: The night is cold; hot soup would be best.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等着你分我。
lines.en: I will not snatch it; I will wait for my share.

lines.zh: 你把碗放下，退后两步。
lines.en: Put the bowl down and step back two paces.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我给你唱首长的。
lines.en: Once I am full, I will sing you a long one.

lines.zh: 那碗汤的热气，勾着我。
lines.en: The steam off that bowl pulls at me.

lines.zh: 你留着点心，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Keep that snack out and I'll help myself.

lines.zh: 你撞歪了我的翅膀。
lines.en: You knocked my wing crooked.

lines.zh: 夜雀的歌声被你撞断了。
lines.en: You bumped the night sparrow's song off key.

lines.zh: 我退开，爪子在地上一滑。
lines.en: I step back, and my claws slip on the ground.

lines.zh: 我唱歌的时候，夜里没人敢走。
lines.en: When I sing, no one dares walk at night.

lines.zh: 我撞到你，先开口的是我。
lines.en: I bumped you, but I speak first.

lines.zh: 我的歌被这一撞打断了。
lines.en: That bump cut my song in half.

lines.zh: 你肩膀好硬，我额头疼。
lines.en: Your shoulder is hard; my forehead aches.

lines.zh: 我扶住墙，才没摔倒。
lines.en: I catch the wall and keep my feet.

lines.zh: 我们撞一起，羽毛和灰尘乱飞。
lines.en: We collide, and feathers and dust fly.

lines.zh: 下次你让让，我赶着去唱。
lines.en: Next time make way; I am off to sing.

lines.zh: 我们合唱一首，试试合不合。
lines.en: Let us sing one together and see if we blend.

lines.zh: 你的音准不错，跟我来。
lines.en: Your pitch is good; follow me.

lines.zh: 我把最长的尾羽给你看。
lines.en: I show you my longest tail feather.

lines.zh: 夜里我们一起唱到天亮。
lines.en: We will sing together until dawn.

lines.zh: 你别抢拍，等我起头。
lines.en: Do not rush the beat; wait for me to start.

lines.zh: 我在树上给你留了个位置。
lines.en: I saved you a spot up in the tree.

lines.zh: 你唱低音，我唱高的。
lines.en: You take the low part; I will take the high.

lines.zh: 这首只唱给一个人听。
lines.en: This one is sung for one listener only.

lines.zh: 我们的调子终于对上了。
lines.en: Our tunes have finally matched.

lines.zh: 明晚还在这里，别迟到。
lines.en: Same place tomorrow night; do not be late.

lines.zh: 我叼起这根亮亮的线头。
lines.en: I pick up this shiny bit of thread.

lines.zh: 地上有片羽毛，不是我的。
lines.en: A feather on the ground, and not mine.

lines.zh: 这颗果子我收了，路上吃。
lines.en: I take this berry for the road.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块碎镜片，照见自己。
lines.en: I pick up a shard of mirror and see myself.

lines.zh: 会响的东西，我都想叼走。
lines.en: Anything that rattles, I want to carry off.

lines.zh: 我把草茎叼在嘴里，像指挥棒。
lines.en: I carry a grass stem like a baton.

lines.zh: 这粒种子太小，差点漏掉。
lines.en: This seed is so small I nearly missed it.

lines.zh: 我捡了两个，一个给你。
lines.en: I picked up two; one is for you.

lines.zh: 亮片卡在爪缝里，我甩了甩。
lines.en: A sequin stuck between my claws; I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 我把它藏进树洞，明天再来。
lines.en: I hide it in the tree hollow and return tomorrow.

lines.zh: 那边有脚步声，只有一个人。
lines.en: Footsteps over there, and only one person.

lines.zh: 夜里的独行者，正合我意。
lines.en: A lone walker at night suits me well.

lines.zh: 有人在黑里乱摸，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone gropes in the dark; I hear them.

lines.zh: 它踩断树枝，位置暴露了。
lines.en: It snapped a branch and gave its position away.

lines.zh: 那只东西在偷我的果子。
lines.en: That thing is stealing my berries.

lines.zh: 我的歌还没唱完，它就来了。
lines.en: I had not finished my song when it came.

lines.zh: 草丛里有翅膀扑腾的声音。
lines.en: Wings are beating somewhere in the grass.

lines.zh: 有人在树下停住，哼起小调。
lines.en: Someone stops beneath my tree and hums a tune.

lines.zh: 我先开嗓，让它知道我在这。
lines.en: I will sing first so it knows I am here.

lines.zh: 风向变了，味道飘过来了。
lines.en: The wind shifted, and the scent came with it.

lines.zh: 我吸一口气，把音吊高。
lines.en: I draw a breath and raise the note.

lines.zh: 它还在看别处，正好。
lines.en: It is still looking elsewhere; perfect.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀张开，站稳。
lines.en: I spread my wings and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 它听不见我，我踩着拍子靠近。
lines.en: It cannot hear me; I approach on the beat.

lines.zh: 我数三下，第三下开口。
lines.en: I count three, and on the third I sing.

lines.zh: 我的声音会先到。
lines.en: My voice will arrive before I do.

lines.zh: 它眼睛开始花了。
lines.en: Its eyes are starting to blur.

lines.zh: 我在它背后，最后一个音留给它。
lines.en: I am behind it; the last note is for it.

lines.zh: 再一步，就到我的音域里。
lines.en: One more step and it is in my range.

lines.zh: 我把爪子扣紧地面。
lines.en: I dig my claws into the ground.

lines.zh: 我一个高音砸过去。
lines.en: I hurl a high note at it.

lines.zh: 翅膀一扫，把它推开。
lines.en: One sweep of my wing shoves it back.

lines.zh: 我啄它的手背。
lines.en: I peck the back of its hand.

lines.zh: 我尖啸着撞过去，羽翼扇你脸。
lines.en: I shriek and ram you, wings slapping your face.

lines.zh: 它捂耳朵，我就撞过去。
lines.en: It covers its ears, so I charge.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，它退了半步。
lines.en: I shriek, and it retreats half a step.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽扫过它的脸。
lines.en: My tail feathers brush across its face.

lines.zh: 我踩它一脚，赶紧跳开。
lines.en: I stamp on it once and hop away.

lines.zh: 嗓子喊哑了，也值。
lines.en: My voice is raw, but it was worth it.

lines.zh: 打完我理了理羽毛。
lines.en: When it is over I tidy my feathers.

lines.zh: 夜里第一声鸟叫，是我。
lines.en: The first birdsong of the night is mine.

lines.zh: 我从树梢落下来，翅膀还没收。
lines.en: I drop from the treetop, wings still open.

lines.zh: 我踩着月光落地。
lines.en: I land on a patch of moonlight.

lines.zh: 草丛里传来一句哼唱，然后是我。
lines.en: A hum comes from the grass, and then me.

lines.zh: 我抖抖羽毛，站直了。
lines.en: I shake out my feathers and straighten up.

lines.zh: 天黑了，该我出场了。
lines.en: It is dark; my turn has come.

lines.zh: 我从枝头跳下，落在你面前。
lines.en: I hop down from the branch and land before you.

lines.zh: 这一带今晚归我唱。
lines.en: This whole area is mine to sing tonight.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，先试了一个音。
lines.en: I open my beak and try a single note.

lines.zh: 夜风把我送到这里。
lines.en: The night wind carried me to this place.

lines.zh: 火太亮，我的眼睛一下就花了。
lines.en: The fire is so bright my eyes blur at once.

lines.zh: 从树上摔下来，翅膀没接住我。
lines.en: I fell from the tree and my wings failed me.

lines.zh: 水灌进嗓子，我唱不出来了。
lines.en: Water fills my throat, and I cannot sing.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我耳朵里全是回音。
lines.en: A blast, and my ears are full of echoes.

lines.zh: 那东西擦过我的尾羽。
lines.en: That thing grazed my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 符卡的光压住我的声音。
lines.en: The spell card's light smothers my voice.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，高音上不去。
lines.en: On an empty stomach I cannot reach the high notes.

lines.zh: 雷声比我响，我不服。
lines.en: The thunder is louder than me, and I resent it.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我收不住翅膀。
lines.en: There is nothing below, and I cannot pull my wings up.
